item.title: Suzuki Auto Opens 3S Dealership In Batangas City
item.description: Suzuki Philippines Incorporated (SPH) expands its presence in Batangas with the opening of Suzuki Auto Batangas City—its newest dealership serving customers in Batangas City and its surrounding communities. Read More »

item.title: Ford Extends Truck Month Offers This October
item.description: Ford Philippines is extending its Ford Truck Month promotion until the end of October, allowing more customers to enjoy exclusive deals that deliver more value to the Ford ownership experience. Read More »

item.title: First-Ever Porsche Cayenne Electric Has Landed In The Philippines
item.description: Porsche Philippines has officially launched the first-ever Cayenne Electric. Combining motorsports technology with new levels of technology and luxury, the Cayenne Electric takes its place as Porsche’s most versatile “sportscar.” Read More »

item.title: Porsche Sweeps IMSA Michelin Endurance Cup Titles
item.description: Porsche Penske Motorsport caps the 2026 endurance season with victory at Road Atlanta as Porsche customer teams secure podium finishes in both GT classes. Read More »

item.title: Tesla PH Tweaks Model Y L For Faster Acceleration
item.description: If a 5-second 0 to 100 km/h time for a three-row SUV still isn’t blistering fast for you, how about if Tesla managed to cut it down by 0.5 seconds to 4.5 seconds? That’s exactly what’s happened with the Model Y L. Read More »
